description_for_human: Generates complex Multi-Agent Swarm prompt templates for Hermes, CrewAI, and AutoGen frameworks.
description_for_model: A powerful prompt engineering tool for generating production-ready Multi-Agent Swarm templates that embody Swarm Intelligence and Agent Orchestration best practices. This tool creates complete, ready-to-use collaboration frameworks for Hermes (OpenAI Swarm), CrewAI (Role-Based), and AutoGen (Conversational) patterns. Users input their goal and select a framework style, and the tool generates a comprehensive prompt template with three specialized agents (Researcher, Analyst, Writer). Perfect for Prompt Engineering workflows and AI agent development.
